priorityList: Cast Reaver's Glaive whenever available to apply Reaver's Mark and gain offensive buffs.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to enter Metamorphosis and trigger Fel-Scarred's Demonsurge.
Use Metamorphosis as your primary cooldown, ideally after an Eye Beam or when Eye Beam is on cooldown.
Cast Essence Break during Metamorphosis, ensuring you have enough Fury and Blade Dance is available.
Prioritize the empowered 'Demonsurge' version of Death Sweep while in Metamorphosis.
Prioritize the empowered 'Demonsurge' version of Annihilation if Death Sweep is on cooldown.
Cast Death Sweep (or Blade Dance if not in Meta) on cooldown, especially within an Essence Break window.
Use The Hunt on cooldown, ideally while Metamorphosis is active but outside of the Essence Break window.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury and trigger Ragefire AoE damage.
Use Vengeful Retreat to trigger the Initiative crit buff or the Inertia damage buff if talented.
Use Fel Rush to consume Inertia triggers or as a movement/filler ability in AoE.
Cast Annihilation (or Chaos Strike) to dump excess Fury, prioritizing targets with Reaver's Mark.
Use Felblade as your primary generator if you are low on Fury and not capping.
Cast Throw Glaive as a filler if you are talented into Soulscar or cannot reach targets in melee range.
Pick up Soul Fragments if your Fury is low (<= 40) to regain resources.
